prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW six-icon raster asset sheet for a children's educational game.
References: attached robot and stamp are style references ONLY for rounded friendly shapes, bold clean dark navy contour and polished cel shading. DO NOT draw either reference subject or their lettering.

LAYOUT: landscape 3:2 canvas, ideally 1536x1024. Invisible 3-column x 2-row grid with perfectly equal square cells. Exactly six separated item groups in reading order, centered within cells, each group's longest dimension about 75% of the cell dimension. Same consistent icon scale and gentle three-quarter front view, showing front and right side. Ample equal clear margins. No actual grid lines.
BACKGROUND: genuine transparent alpha, fully empty between icons. No floor, no ground shadow, no glow or halo, no backdrop of any color. No checkerboard.

STYLE: simple instantly recognizable clean storybook game icons, thick smooth dark-navy outlines, rounded forms. Solid flat even fills. For each base color use exactly ONE discrete softer shadow tone and ONE small solid highlight shape, clean edged cel shading. Gloss comes from the small highlight, NOT gradients. No texture, grain, mottling, patchiness, washed-out areas or gradients. Restrained detail.
PALETTE: white or warm cream main bodies. Each item only one or two accents from teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Dark navy for outlines/lenses. Exception: tiny green status light specifically requested on purifier. No other colors. No text, letters, digits, AI, labels, logos or branding anywhere. Each screen contains at most one simple pictogram, no interface clutter.

ROW 1 LEFT: SMART FRIDGE. Cream two-door refrigerator, separate top and bottom doors, two simple handles. Small teal screen with a single cream bowl pictogram. One restrained highlight on body. No food outside fridge.
ROW 1 CENTER: ROBOT VACUUM. Low round white robotic vacuum cleaner, simple front bumper, one teal top button. No paths, sparkles, cleaning effects or extra accessories.
ROW 1 RIGHT: PET CARE HELPER. Cream pet camera and treat dispenser combined into one friendly simple upright device. Large circular navy lens near top, small treat opening below. Small coral pet bowl beside its base. No pets, no heart bubbles, no floating decorations.
ROW 2 LEFT: SECURITY CAMERA. White dome security camera attached to a small simple wall mount, tiny coral indicator light. Visible navy lens under dome. No wall section, no surveillance rays or waves.
ROW 2 CENTER: SMART AIR PURIFIER. Tall cream rounded tower purifier, just a few broad sky-blue vent slits, tiny green status light. No air waves, leaves or extra effects.
ROW 2 RIGHT: SMART WASHING MACHINE. Cream front-loading washer, big circular sky-blue door window, one simple control dial and small screen showing a single plain T-shirt pictogram. No other buttons, no laundry outside, no bubbles outside.

Every object whole, uncropped and separated. Uniform line weight. No text anywhere. Transparent output mandatory.
revisionPrompt:
Refine this six-icon sheet only in rendering simplicity. Keep all six object designs, colors, reading order, gentle 3/4 view and thick navy outlines. Remove all soft gradients and surface texture. Flat solid uniform fills, each material with just one discrete shadow color block and one small highlight shape. Especially simplify the vacuum trim, both camera lenses, washer window, and control knobs: no multiple shine spots, no reflections layered over reflections. Small bone treat should be sunny yellow, not brown. Cream/white bodies, teal/coral/sunny-yellow/sky-blue accent palette, tiny green purifier indicator. Keep screens as a single bowl icon and a single shirt icon. No letters, numbers or text. No new effects.
Background MUST be genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside objects, including between icons. No cloudy backdrop, ground shadows, halos or glows. Six centered separate icons in a 3 column x 2 row grid, equal square cells, each whole group fits comfortably within 75% of cell size. Clean flat cel-shaded game assets.
